messages:
devon_csm: Quick triage - AtlanticFoods. Usage down ~68% last 30d, active seats 42 -> 13, API calls/day 18k -> 4.8k. CFO left, procurement starting competitor eval w/ ZettaAI today. Renewal ~8w. Need plan.
maria_am: Oof. Can you paste the dashboard numbers + top flows?
devon_csm: dashboard snapshot: https://app.redwood.example/d/atlantic/usage (internal) 
- seats: 42 -> 13
- daily API calls: 18,200 -> 4,760
- top route 'invoice-parsing' usage down 75%
- percent of traffic from 'accounts-payable' team fell to 12%
aj_sales: FYI I had a call last week. Procurement asked for a cost/latency comparison vs ZettaAI. Sales heard Zetta offering 20% cheaper for committed PO + 12-week PoC.
sara_pm: Any errors or broken integrations? Could be a UI rollout that killed adoption.
kevin_eng: Checked infra logs - no error spikes. Latency P50/P95 stable. No deploys in last 3 weeks. ops-bot: No incidents reported in last 30d.
maria_am: Proposed next steps:
1) DEVON - schedule 30m call with Atlantic procurement + interim CFO this week.
2) AJ - prepare a one-pager comparing real latencies, TCO (we can use last 30d numbers) and include a short discount/PoC offer.
3) KEVIN - offer a 2-week reverse-test PoC on Dedicated with reserved capacity to show stable latency; capture perf numbers.
4) SARA - prepare enablement snippets to get AP team's flows back into the product (quick wins + onboarding checklist).
5) DEVON - ask for exec sponsor intro and whether Zetta has already ingested data.
maria_am: I'll own coordinated outreach if you drop the assets here.
devon_csm: Draft outreach email (sending now):
```
Hi Ana,
We noticed platform activity drop from your AP team. We think a short 30-minute sync this week will help us understand the procurement evaluation and outline a low-friction PoC to validate latency and cost. Would Thursday 10:30am GMT or Friday 2pm GMT work?
—Devon (CSM)
```
aj_sales: I'll prep the pricing matrix and include a 12-week PoC term sheet. If Procurement asks about data handling, we can highlight Private option + KMS.
kevin_eng: I can provision a small Dedicated pool for a 2-week isolated test tomorrow if you confirm.
maria_am: Risk level: HIGH. Renewal likely at risk if we don't get a committed PoC or exec touchpoint within 10 days.
devon_csm: Scheduling call now. Please join if you can — AJ for commercial, Kevin for infra, Sara for enablement. I'll ping once confirmed. :speech_balloon:
